about: Adam M. Balkan is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Boca Raton, Florida area. Providing legal representation in Florida for a variety of different issues, Adam Balkan was selected to Super Lawyers for 2015 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Adam M. Balkan attended law school. Adam Balkan was enrolled at Nova Southeastern University Shepard Broad College of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 1994. Adam Balkan was admitted to the practice of law in 1995.

Attorneys like Adam M. Balkan are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.

Adam Balkan represents clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues. Additional legal issues represented include Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff, Business Litigation, Civil Litigation: Plaintiff, Professional Liability: Plaintiff and Schools & Education.
